rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Rs Fast MCP is a Rust framework for building MCP servers and clients using async-first patterns with tokio and actix-web. It provides multiple transport options including stdio and SSE/HTTP, built-in authentication via OAuth2, OIDC, and JWT, along with middleware for rate limiting and result caching. The framework includes type-safe interfaces, dedicated managers for tools, resources, and prompts, and comprehensive examples covering use cases from basic echo servers to full OAuth integrations.
